experience.description: A progression from frontend interfaces to full-stack product development.

about.headline: A frontend foundation. A broader perspective.
paragraphs: My background combines computer applications education with hands-on web development. I completed my MCA at Babu Banarasi Das University, following a BCA from the University of Lucknow.

At Codetrex, my work has grown from frontend development into application flows, APIs, administration, payments, and data access. Alongside company work, I have delivered an independent client website from development through deployment.
